text.p: Foxmoor Industries said after the stock market closed on Wednesday that it has begun an investigation into the financial position of the company and its financial reporting practices.

"After our initial review of the company's financial position, we have concerns about the true value of the company's assets and the accuracy of its prior financial reporting," said Paul Eagland, chairman and chief executive officer, in a press release.

"We are conducting a thorough review of the company's books and records and hope to be in position within the next week to provide our shareholders and the investment community with a report on the company's financial position," he said.
